While having a meeting with Fine Motion
over a cup of tea...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, where did the sugar bowl go...?
Ah! Found it, found it~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: (Isn't that a lot of sugar cubes...?)
(Aren't there a lot of sugar cubes...?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How about we adjust based on the race results?
I think it'd be best if we can stay flexible.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then it's a deal♪
All right, let's keep giving it our all tomorrow too!

It doesn't show on her face at all, but craving sweets is likely due to fatigue.
It might be best to review her race schedule.
